description: This file initializes and renders the root React component into the DOM. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component, then mounts the App component within a StrictMode wrapper onto the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
